META.title: SFlight Discovery Atlas
META.lede: One travel-booking app, read end to end: two Fiori elements apps, one CDS model and a CAP Node.js backend in TypeScript. The repo also ships a Java backend; it is out of scope and ignored here.

RISKS.t: Passenger PII open to any caller
RISKS.d: Master data is @cds.autoexpose without @restrict, so /processor/Passenger and /analytics/Passenger return names, street, phone and e-mail. With no service-level @requires this includes unauthenticated calls (verify behind the approuter).
RISKS.test: GET /processor/Passenger and /analytics/Passenger as anonymous and as role-less user rose, expect 401/403.

RISKS.t: Status rules live in the UI only
RISKS.d: Node checks only the draft lock before accept/reject. A cancelled travel can be accepted and an accepted one rejected by a direct OData call. The UI hides these buttons via OperationAvailable.
RISKS.test: POST acceptTravel on a cancelled (X) travel, expect 400.

RISKS.d: The @restrict block is commented out, so every booking with prices and customer names is readable without a role.
15 @Common.FieldControl annotations make an accepted travel read-only in Fiori. No handler enforces it, so an edit draft on an accepted travel can still change BookingFee (verify).
RISKS.test: draftEdit + PATCH BookingFee on an accepted travel, expect rejection.

RISKS.d: Create/DeleteHidden hide booking changes unless the travel is Open. The server has no matching check (verify).
RISKS.test: POST a Booking into the draft of an accepted travel, expect rejection.

RISKS.d: The UI offers the action only for Open; the UPDATE excludes only Accepted, so a cancelled travel still gets discounted.
RISKS.test: deductDiscount on an X travel, expect 400.

RISKS.d: When the travel is gone, the error message reads travel.ID from undefined: a TypeError and a 500 instead of a 404.
RISKS.test: deductDiscount on a deleted TravelUUID, expect 404 with message.

RISKS.d: max(TravelID) is read and incremented on CREATE. Two parallel activations can get the same ID.
RISKS.test: Activate two drafts in parallel, assert distinct TravelIDs.

RISKS.d: All 9 OData tests run as alice (a CAP default admin). No test exercises reviewer, processor or a role-less user.
RISKS.test: Role x operation matrix test (see TST).

RISKS.d: Declared and granted to processor and admin, but not implemented: calls fail with 501.
RISKS.test: Call the action, expect a created travel, or remove it from the model.

RISKS.d: AnalyticsService annotates my.Airport and my.FlightConnection directly, so its labels leak into TravelService too.
RISKS.test: Architecture rule: srv/*.cds may only annotate its own projections.

RISKS.d: All FlightPrices are summed as USD regardless of their currency.
RISKS.test: Seed a EUR booking, assert aggregation either converts or groups by currency.
